@deskInvNoticePaid.description: Notice: a payer paid an invoice this wallet issued; the wallet finalized it. payer is the contact name or a short address; amount is the number only; EPIC follows it.

@deskInvNoticeDeclined.description: Warning notice: the payer declined an invoice this wallet issued; the wallet withdrew it.

deskInvNoticeIssuedExpired: An invoice you issued expired unpaid.

@deskInvNoticeIssuedExpired.description: Notice: an invoice this wallet issued ran out of time unpaid.

deskInvNoticeWithdrawn: {service} withdrew an invoice before you answered it.

@deskInvNoticeWithdrawn.description: Notice: a service withdrew an invoice that was waiting for the user. service is the user's label for it.

deskInvNoticeExpired: An invoice expired before you answered it.

@deskInvNoticeExpired.description: Notice: an invoice waiting for the user ran out of time.

deskInvNoticeUnknownPayment: A payment for an invoice this device did not issue arrived. It stays on the server for a day for your other device with this wallet: open the wallet there to finish it.

@deskInvNoticeUnknownPayment.description: Warning notice (desktop and phone): the payment of an invoice this install does not know arrived; LEPIC leaves it on the relay for a day for another install on the same recovery phrase, which may have issued it. Unverified: names no sender.

deskInvNoticeUnknownAnswer: An answer to a payment this device did not send arrived. It stays on the server for a day for your other device with this wallet: open the wallet there to finish it.

@deskInvNoticeUnknownAnswer.description: Warning notice (desktop and phone): the answer to a send this install does not know arrived; LEPIC leaves it on the relay for a day for another install on the same recovery phrase, which may have made the send. Unverified: names no sender.

deskInvNoticeReceiveSuperseded: Your other device with this wallet took a payment this device was also receiving. Recheck balance to see it here.

@deskInvNoticeReceiveSuperseded.description: Notice (desktop and phone): another install on the same recovery phrase answered the same incoming payment and the sender completed that one, so this install's copy of the receive ended. 'Recheck balance' is the name of the rescan action in Settings.
